reason: The plugin connects DSH to Context7 to search libraries and retrieve current, version-pinned documentation and code examples through two model tools.

summaries.zh: 通过 Context7 API 搜索软件库并获取当前、可指定版本的文档与代码示例。
summaries.en: Search libraries and retrieve current, version-pinned documentation and code examples through the Context7 API.

capabilities: Searches libraries through the Context7 Public API
Retrieves version-pinned documentation and code examples
Sends an optional configured API key for authenticated requests
